node.statement: If V lies in calU_{delta-C_pol*(epsilon_r*delta+delta^2)}, put f(V)=(1/2)(V^dagger bold-dot V-J), so ||f(V)||<delta-C_pol*(epsilon_r*delta+delta^2) by def-approximate-unitary-space. Node 1.1.2 gives ||p_V(0,0)||=||g_V(0)||<=||f(V)||+C_0*(epsilon_r*delta+delta^2). Choose C_pol>=C_0+theta*C_1 with the fixed norm-equivalence allowance C_1; then ||p_V(0,0)||<(1-theta)delta. On the closed max-norm ball of some radius rho<delta with ||p_V(0,0)||+theta*rho<rho, F(z):=z-p_V(z) is a theta-contraction and maps that ball to itself, so its iterates converge to a unique z=(a,q), p_V(a,q)=0, with ||a||,||q||<delta. Uniqueness on the full coordinate box follows from node 1.2.1. By the exact formula for p_V, p_V(a,q)=0 is exactly V=[V bold-dot (J+a+g_V(a))] bold-dot (J+q), where the bracketed factor is unitary by lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control.
